name: Building Leaders teen program
what_you_do: A free after-school program for teens. It has homework help, science and art projects, college visits, financial aid workshops and service hours. Gads Hill says teens can also find job chances through After School Matters and One Summer Chicago.
who_can_apply: Students ages 13 to 18. Teens must attend at least 85 percent of sessions, go to required events, and turn in each report card.
pay_detail: The program is free. Pay for the jobs it links to is not stated.
duration: School year, plus summer programming June 16 to August 15
deadline_text: Enrolling now per the site. No deadline stated.
how_to_apply: Fill out the sign-up form on the Youth Services page. Or contact Claudia Pavon, Youth Enrollment Specialist. Email: cpavon@gadshillcenter.org. Phone: 312-226-0963 ext. 224.
notes: The jobs come through other programs (After School Matters, One Summer Chicago), which have their own sign-up rules. The page does not list where the teen program meets. Ask the enrollment contact. The page lists Pilsen and North Lawndale only for the younger Junior Building Leaders program.
